# shadcn

Use this skill for component composition and accessible UI primitive usage.

## When to Use This Skill

- Building component features from primitives.
- Refactoring repeated UI patterns into reusable components.
- Standardizing interaction and accessibility behavior.

## Quick Start

1. Choose suitable primitives and composition model.
2. Implement semantic markup and keyboard behavior.
3. Verify style consistency with token and utility usage.

## Step-by-Step Workflows

### Build Component

1. Define API and variant strategy.
2. Implement with composable primitives.
3. Validate a11y and responsive behavior.

### Refactor Component

1. Collapse duplicated variants.
2. Normalize state and interaction handling.
3. Preserve behavior parity with tests.

## Gotchas

- Do not bypass accessibility primitives without replacement behavior.
- Do not overuse one-off variants instead of composable APIs.
- Do not ship components without focus-visible and keyboard validation.
